title: Origin story: Raven
description: Raven is the creator-trickster of the Pacific Northwest, who stole the sun, moon, and stars from the hoarding chief and released them into the sky. He gave mankind fresh water, salmon, and daylight — usually while pursuing some selfish scheme that accidentally benefited everyone.

title: Ability profile: Raven
description: Ranked abilities: Trickery — rank 100/100; Cunning — rank 99/100; Transformation — rank 98/100; Accidental benevolence — rank 97/100; Flight — rank 95/100.

title: Power ranking: Raven
description: Powers: Shapeshifting into any form; Theft of cosmic treasures; The raven's all-seeing flight.

title: Stamina feats: Raven
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Schemed across the whole creation; Never stops meddling.

title: Crossover notes: Raven
description: Raven crosses naturally with: creation, trickery, light, transformation.

title: Cultural impact: Raven
description: The light-bringer who meant to steal; creation by appetite.
